Fact: training_method
What to find: Main stages and methods of training (pretraining, SFT, preference optimisation/DPO, RL, distillation, merging).
Card sections that often contain it: Training, Training Procedure, Post-training

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Pretraining on ~40 trillion tokens of multimodal data (Llama 4 Scout), followed by safety fine-tuning using human-generated and synthetic data; the card does not detail other post-training stages (e.g., SFT, DPO, RL).
quotes: Llama 4 Scout was pretrained on ~40 trillion tokens and Llama 4 Maverick was pretrained on ~22 trillion tokens of multimodal data from a mix of publicly available, licensed data and information from Meta’s products and services.
We employ a multi-faceted approach to data collection, combining human-generated data from our vendors with synthetic data to mitigate potential safety risks.
